What is the Breeze Affiliate Program?

Breeze, the latest offering from the world’s largest eSIM solution provider.

Partner with Breeze, a pioneering force in the telecom sector, and promote our range of eSIM packages to your customers and followers. Our affiliate program allows you to leverage the Breeze brand and world class connectivity to enhance your proposition, earn a steady revenue stream on plans sold, and provide customers with the industry's best global plans spanning over 150 countries. Work with the world’s largest eSIM solution provider and earn up to 20% commission on sales and top-ups.

We offer a 30 day referral window. If your customers or followers return within those 30 days and purchase a new bundle or top-up an existing eSIM you will earn additional commission on those sales.

Terms and Conditions

Welcome to Breezesim! Thanks for joining our Affiliate Program.


From 1st April 2025, this Affiliate Program will be provided by Breezesim Limited. Breezesim Limited is a company incorporated under the laws of England and Wales, whose company registration number is 16221665 and whose registered address is at First Floor, 18-19 South Bar, Banbury, OX16 9AF


Until 31st March 2025, this Affiliate Program was offered by eSIM Go Limited is a company incorporated under the laws of England and Wales, whose company registration number is 12465777 and whose registered address is at 8 North Bar Street, Banbury, Oxfordshire, OX16 0TB.


These following Terms and Conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an Affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner. We may update or amend these Terms and Conditions at any time and your continued participation in the Program constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms and Conditions.

 

1. Approval or Rejection of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

You confirm that the information that you provide to us is true, accurate and complete. You agree to inform us immediately of any change to your details by contacting: affiliates@breezesim-go.com. We will use your personal data in accordance with these Terms and Conditions and our privacy policy which you can find on our website.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

 

You will follow all reasonable instructions we give you in connection with marketing your Affiliate link. Affiliate may advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram using your own domain, or run offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers. Affiliate adverts that directly promote our website, use our brand name or other intellectual property are not allowed unless we have provided prior written permission. Adverts must comply with applicable laws and must not contain inaccurate or misleading information.

 

 

 

 

3. Commission and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (including but not limited to, tax, shipping cost etc). For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, Affiliate can invite others to become their downline Affiliate. If any downline Affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline Affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other Affiliates into the system, share network link and any other Affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline Affiliate.

 

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the Affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the Affiliate Program, they can do so by contacting: affiliates@breezesim-go.com.

 

You must comply with these Terms and Conditions. If we determine (in our sole and absolute discretion) that your participation in the Program does not comply these Terms and Conditions, we may suspend your affiliate link or remove you from the Program.

If you break an important Term or Condition we can remove you from Affiliate Program immediately. If you break a less important Term or Condition, we may suspend your affiliate link and ask you to put it right. If you do not put it right within seven (7) days of us asking you to, we can remove you from Affiliate Program.

 

If Affiliate link is not used for a period of twelve (12) months, we may remove you from Affiliate Program.

If we are required to do so by law or a decision of a Competent Authority, (which means any person which has relevant statutory authority over the Affiliate, Merchant or the Affiliate Program) we may remove you from Affiliate Program.

 

8. Liability

We are only liable to you as set out in this Agreement. We have no other duty or liability to you. Nothing in this Agreement removes or limits our liability for death or personal injury caused by something we have done or failed to do or for any fraudulent misrepresentation we may have made to you.

Except as set out in the preceding paragraph, our total liability to you for something we or anyone who works for us does or does not do will be limited to £1,000 for one incident or £3,000 for a number of incidents within any twelve (12) month period.

We are not liable to you in any way for any loss or damage that was not reasonably foreseeable at the time you registered for Affiliate Program. This includes but is not limited to loss of income; business; anticipated profits; loss of property or loss of use of property.

You must tell us about any claim as soon as reasonably possible. We will not be liable to you if we cannot carry out our duties or provide affiliate link because of something beyond our control.

 

9. General

English law will apply to this Agreement and any disputes will be settled in the Courts of England and Wales

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to affiliates@breezesim-go.com for support.
